description: The preset lives in another organisation because this library is released next to the VanillaBP repositories and updates on the same rhythm. It is a public repository, so Renovate reads it from here as well, and the night window, the Vienna time zone and the grouping rules stay written down once.

Everything this repository builds on is covered by the groups of that preset: Spring Boot and Spring Framework, the testing dependencies including Testcontainers, and the GitHub Actions of the workflows.
